scope: M21 diagnostic profile aggregation from four perf and twelve CPU-only analysis JSON artifacts
interpretation: diagnostic measurements; not a new policy acceptance

graph.wall_scope: includes event recording and end synchronization; not isolated host-launch latency

api.wall_scope: includes event recording and end synchronization; not isolated host-launch latency

frozen.api_name_filter: CUDA runtime/driver API names beginning cuda or cu; names not exported
caveats: CPU labels are launch-submission ranges, not GPU execution intervals.
GPU stage sums are correlated kernel durations from this same-stream capture only; they are not unprofiled performance measurements.
Stage and GPU durations are not independent wall-time components and should not be summed as an exclusive critical path.
Raw StringIds, kernel names, process environment metadata, and input paths are not exported.
